decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The works to which this consent relates, must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this consent.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Location plan received 04/05/2016. Covering letter produced by Abercrombie & court developments ltd dated 3 May 2016 and received 04/05/2016. Method Statement MS001 produced by Abercrombie & court developments ltd received 09/05/2016. Structural Engineers Report  5339/RF produced by Richard Fryers Associates dated 29 April 2016 received on 10/06/2016. 4mm clear toughened Northwood Glass (without any marks) received and inspected on 28/06/2016. Statement of Historical Significance received 30/06/2016. Extract of method statement 1694/PEB/6 May 2016 produced by Peter Brades Architects dated 6 May 2016 and received 06/07/2015. Plans reference 1694/03 Rev A, 1694/04 Rev A, 1694/05 Rev A and 1694/06 Rev A received on 13/07/2016) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - This consent does not permit the demolition or dismantling of any part of the building, or the removal of any internal/external feature, floor, wall or ceiling surface, except in so far as the alterations hereby approved necessitate the removal of certain parts of the existing structure as specifically shown on the approved drawings.
description: Replace existing and damaged 3mm float glass with 4mm "toughened" glass to the conservatory
